name: Escondido Battalion & Training Ship Kit Carson (Naval Sea Cadet Corps)
meeting_note: Founded 2011; drills two weekend days a month during the school year at Escondido Police & Fire HQ, 1163 N. Centre City Pkwy.

name: Gunfighter Squadron & Training Ship TopGun (Naval Sea Cadet Corps)
meeting_note: Aviation-oriented squadron formed 1973; own site lists an upcoming drill (Aug 29, 2026) confirming current activity.

name: Michael A. Monsoor Battalion (Naval Sea Cadet Corps)
meeting_note: Construction-battalion-oriented unit; confirmed active via a November 2023 NBC 7 San Diego news report on equipment stolen from the unit at Camp Pendleton.

name: Chief MCM-14 Division (Naval Sea Cadet Corps)
meeting_note: Named for former mine-countermeasures ship USS Chief (MCM-14); listed as a currently sponsored unit on Navy League San Diego's own youth-programs page. No independent unit website found -- weaker verification than this roster's other three entries.
